question: Which of the following diseases is caused by protozoa?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Malaria**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Malaria** is a disease caused by a type of **protozoan parasite** called **Plasmodium**.
 
• The infection is transmitted to humans through the bite of an infected **female Anopheles mosquito**, which acts as a vector for the disease.
 
• There are several species of **Plasmodium** that cause malaria, including **P. falciparum, P. vivax, P. ovale,** and **P. malariae**. Of these, **P. falciparum** is the most severe and life-threatening.
